title: The Wise Owl's Lesson
virtue: Learning from Experience and Seeking Wisdom
claude_note: Claude communicates via THOUGHT BUBBLES - his thoughts are narrated by the Narrator voice, not spoken directly

scenes.title: The Mountain Path
scenes.setting: Dramatic mountain path with wind blowing, adventure ahead

lines.text: Sir James and Claude climbed the winding mountain path as the wind whispered secrets through the ancient trees.
Gramps said there's a wise owl who lives at the top of this mountain. She knows the answers to any question!
Claude's ears perked up. He could sense something magical waiting for them above the clouds.

scenes.title: The Ancient Tree
scenes.setting: Massive ancient oak tree with glowing windows

lines.text: At the mountain's peak stood the most magnificent tree Sir James had ever seen - an ancient oak with windows that glowed like stars.
This must be where the Wise Owl lives! Look at all those books in the windows, Claude!
A soft hooting sound drifted down from the highest branch, welcoming them to the tree of knowledge.

scenes.title: Meeting the Wise Owl
scenes.setting: Inside the tree library with the majestic owl

lines.text: Inside the tree was a magnificent library, and perched on a golden branch sat the most beautiful owl Sir James had ever seen.
Good evening, Wise Owl. I am Sir James, and I've come seeking wisdom.
The owl's golden eyes sparkled. 'Wisdom is not given, young knight. It is earned through questions and listening.'

scenes.title: The First Question
scenes.setting: Sir James sitting with the owl, books floating around

lines.text: Books floated gently around them as the Wise Owl leaned closer to Sir James.
How do I become truly wise, like you and Gramps?
The owl smiled. 'By admitting what you don't know, and having the courage to learn. That is the first step to wisdom.'

scenes.title: The Book of Mistakes
scenes.setting: Owl showing Sir James a special golden book

lines.text: The Wise Owl flew to a shelf and returned with a golden book that seemed to glow from within.
What is this special book? It's so beautiful!
'This is the Book of Mistakes,' said the owl. 'Every wise creature has one. Our mistakes teach us more than our successes.'
The Wise Owl looked at Claude with knowing eyes. 'Your companion already understands this lesson.'
Claude? What do you mean?
'Watch how he listens before acting, observes before moving. Dogs are natural students of wisdom.'

scenes.title: The Gift of Curiosity
scenes.setting: Owl giving Sir James a glowing feather

lines.text: The Wise Owl plucked a single feather from her wing. It glowed with soft golden light.
For me? Thank you, Wise Owl! I will treasure it always.
'This feather will glow whenever you ask a good question. Never stop being curious, young knight.'

scenes.title: Wisdom Earned
scenes.setting: Sir James and Claude descending mountain at sunrise

lines.text: As Sir James and Claude made their way down the mountain, the sunrise painted the world in gold and pink.
I understand now, Claude. Being wise means always being ready to learn, even from our mistakes!
Claude wagged his tail proudly. His young knight was growing wiser every day.
The wisest people are those who know there's always more to learn. Well done, my boy.
